paragraphs: Chapter 662
Episode 168. Escape, Shuri's ordeal
Beyond the door, instead of the inside of the cave where they had entered the tomb, it was a point in the Calderan Snowfield.
And Jin, as soon as he stepped outside, had to confirm that another urgent situation awaited them.
'I expected it, but the outside world has indeed spent quite a lot of time.'
The landscape of the Calderan Snowfield had changed.
The snowfield, deep enough to sink to the knees, was completely dyed black, and the snowstorm swirling in oppressive gray had also turned pitch-black, embodying chaos.
'Has the entire snowfield been engulfed in chaos?'
Even when he focused his gaze as far as he could see, there was no place that was not black.
The snowstorm of chaos was filled with madness, so those who were not well-trained seemed likely to lose their minds just by being exposed to it.
Kiieek, Kaaaak-!
And the roars of the chaos dragons shaking the sky.
When he looked up, they were firing breaths black as artillery on the ground.
On the ground too, knights engulfed in chaos and monsters that could only be seen in the Black Sea were wriggling.
[Jin, I can't make more dimensional gates... You seem exhausted, too, what should we do?]
Nero was already in a state where he was struggling to stand since Jin first discovered him.
Opening a dimensional gate required a lot of energy or the claw of the Cat God, neither of which was feasible now.
"Don't worry, Nero. I have enough power left to break through this level of siege. And...."
Jin, who was speaking until there, closed his eyes for a moment and heightened his senses.
Other powers were being detected by his senses through the chaos that filled the entire snowfield. Aura, magic, magical energy. Clearly, these were the powers of his companions and allies.
"It seems there are those fighting to save us. If we join them, we should be able to escape without any problem. I'll listen carefully about Nero and Valeria after we escape."
[Really? Did you tell your companions before entering the tomb?]
"Not just companions, but it also includes Zipple and Kinzelo, with whom we have formed a temporary alliance."
[Zipple and Kinzelo!?]
"They are good friends to use in times like these."
[Meow!]
Jin summoned Shuri, made Nero ride on her, and tied up the sealed Valeria.
The non-chaotic energies were not gathered in one place.
North, East, West. Jin first decided whether it would be better to inform them of his location and gather them in one place, or not.
'It would be problematic if we gather and then someone like Rosana or her equivalent shows up and we can't escape.'
The number of allies that can be sensed is not that many.
That meant that the allies who came to save Jin consisted only of a few elite forces.
Therefore, Jin decided to first make his presence known to the weakest among the allies.
Of course, the first people Jin had to find were the Ticani. Since Talaris was injured, Tikan's elites were likely to be relatively weak.
Depending on the situation, it could be best for Jin to save them and join the other forces.
"To the East."
The most familiar energies were to the east.
As Shuri began to run, the gaze of the monsters nearby all focused at once.
Shuri fired a magic beam before Jin even spread his sword qi or magic, disintegrating them without a trace.
[Meooow!]
Fortunately, while heading east, they did not encounter any chaos beings with remaining sanity.
In less than 15 minutes of running, Jin was able to meet the struggling comrades of Tikan.
"Valkas Knight!"
Valkas, Amela, Lata, and Yulian.
These four people from Tikan were in charge of searching the Calderan Snowfield.
"Lord! Valkas old man, it's the lord! Uh, and what's with the cat? Cute!"
"Lord! The Lord has rescued Valeria...!"
Just as Jin had worried, they were struggling quite a bit.
Surrounding them were the bodies of chaos beings that looked like monsters and knights, forming a literal black river and mountain.
"We don't have time, Valkas Knight. Please explain the situation first."
"Five days have passed since the Lord entered the tomb. During that time, the Sword Garden did not directly attack Tikan or other forces, it only contaminated the entire Calderan Snowfield."

That was the reason they were struggling despite the absence of transcendent chaos beings with special ranks. They had been dealing with the endlessly invading chaos for several days since their arrival at the Calderan Snowfield.
"It's a relief that there were no direct attacks outside the Sword Garden. Are there no casualties?"
"None in the Vamel Alliance. I assume the same for the allies, although they may have lost some biological golems and masters."
According to Valkas' report, at least no transcendent chaos beings appeared on the side where the Vamel Alliance was.
Instead, there was news that monsters of the level of the inner demon have been appearing from various parts of the snowfield for several days.
"When they know I've escaped from the tomb, Rosana may immediately send beings with rank from that moment. After discovering me, how did you plan to escape?"
"We decided to use the Dimensional Gate of the leader."
"Good, let's go!"
The atmosphere of the Tikan party changed as soon as Jin joined.
It wasn't just because Jin's safety was confirmed.
Even though his strength was nearly exhausted due to the opening of the tomb and the battle with Luntia, it was not a big deal for him to sweep away ordinary chaos beings even in that state.
The fire orbs formed in both hands were burning dozens of monsters every second.
In the midst of that, he gave the ones that looked like knights a death as painless as possible.
Kinzelo and Zipple were located to the northwest. Shuri, who carried the entire party, was soon able to encounter another force.
The first to meet were Zipple's Hedo and Sandra.
These two were apart from the other Zipple members and were looking for Jin. Of course, it was a result of Sandra's fuss.
She insisted that she couldn't save Mr. Jin by searching in such a lukewarm way (Zipple was sincerely looking for Jin) and started acting separately with Hedo as soon as she arrived at the snowfield.
"Honey! Is it really Mr. Jin!? It's Mr. Jin, right, Hedo!?"
"It's the 12th flagbearer, Miss. So please stop pulling my clothes."
"See, I told you I had to move separately. The fools of our family will still not know that our Jin has returned."
"You and I just found out. We didn't find him, rather the 12th flagbearer found us."
"Mr. Jiiin!"
Sandra, who was running, jumped onto Shuri and tried to hug Jin, but Jin unknowingly avoided her.
As a result, Sandra had no choice but to fall onto Valeria, who was tied behind Jin.
Clang!
The sound of an ice block and a human head colliding rang out.

"Darn it! If I were a little faster, I could've hugged... Ah! So this woman is a very, very precious person who almost made our Honey disappear from the world? I want to break, no, no Sandra. Now, the joy of Jin safely returning takes precedence!"
That's how Sandra also got on Shuri's back.
While Shuri, possessing monstrous strength that could erase a mountain if given time, didn't find the numerous people heavy, she occasionally twisted her head as if uncomfortable.
Hedo, being too large, couldn't ride on Shuri's back and hung on her flank.
Although it didn't look good, Hedo himself didn't seem to mind.
"You seem to have done it, 12th flagbearer."
"Yes, Tower Keeper. Let's express gratitude when we get back. I have many questions about your sword. I think you would have the same curiosity."
"Mr. Jin, what about me?"
"You too, thank you, Sandra."
"If you had said thank you very much, I was thinking of prolonging this woman trapped in ice's remaining life by at least two days. I'm eagerly looking forward to it."
"Very thankful."
"Kyakyakya, that's right!"
Jin, Valeria, Neru, Valkas, Amela, Lata, Yulian, Sandra, Hedo.
Thus, Shuri, carrying a total of nine people, charged forward with vigor again.
But not long after, Shuri had no choice but to carry an additional character.
"Honey, who is that rag-like guy? He seems dead."
"That is a demon called Ranke Halovich, Sandra."
Ranke Halovich. Judging by his condition, it seemed that he had become 'Rampage Ranke', but he had been knocked out from exhaustion after dealing with devil-grade chaos beings for days.
"We're short of room, should we just leave him and go? No, if we load him too, Jin and I can be closer together. And further away from that ice block. Hedo!"
Whack!
Hedo snagged Ranke and threw him onto Shuri's back. Valkas tied him up loosely with a rope.
In this way, the number of people riding or hanging on Shuri continued to increase.
"Bubvar Gaston? He's not a combat member, why did Kinzelo bring him?"
"Hedo!"
Whack!
"...... Ainas Kaligo? Ah, it's not strange since Bubvar is here."
"Hedo!"
Whack! Dangling.
"That one looks like a white wolf tribe assault captain, I don't know his name."
"Hedo!"
Whack!
By the time they reached near Orgal, eventually, about twenty or so people were dangling like fruits on Shuri.
Sandra, who was closely clinging to Jin, looked almost like a flat steamed bun, and Shuri seemed truly tired, frowning.
And the people hanging onto Jin and Shuri realized why they had only been able to face low-level chaos beings up till now when they came face to face with Orgal.
Orgal was facing off against Jephryn and Lionel and Stahl, as well as some unnamed old black knights.
'Orgal... truly a remarkable existence. I thought Lionel wasn't the end, but I didn't expect him to show up so soon. Moreover, those corpses all seem like transcendent chaos beings.'
However, Orgal looked tired. As soon as he saw Jin, he gave a weary smile and waved his hand.
"Oh... I was reaching my limit, but you showed up at a good time. Jin Runckandale. Did you rescue your lover?"
"No, I'm the one who saved Jin, you know? You're mistaken."
"Now that someone I really can't handle is about to pop out, it's perfect. Escape immediately."
Orgal said, parrying Lionel's sword.
Lionel was panting, having lost an arm.
"Do you think we can run away, demon!"
Just as Lionel finished his sentence, a steel door opened between the group and Orgal.
At the same time, a black door of chaos also opened on the opposite side.
"But Orgal, what about Jephil?"
"I can't believe Runckandale will suggest bringing Jephil along. It's best to let those friends find their way back on their own."
"If so, shouldn't an alliance, even if it's a temporary one, at least inform about the escape?"
"Honey, let's just go first! The person coming out of that door over there seems really strong!"
"Miss, Jephil is of your family line."
"What does it matter, Jin seems like he's going to die?"
The one emerging from the door of chaos was none other than Fadler Runckandale.
Orgal also nodded as if to point it out, and Jin nodded in return.
"I will shoot the flare."
"That seems best. Shuri, to the steel door."
"Jin... Runckandale..."
Fadler spoke in a dark voice.
Just as he was about to emerge from the door of chaos, fortunately, Shuri was able to throw herself into the steel door while carrying a lot of people.
Orgal and Jephryn also followed through the steel door, and Fadler could only watch the door they disappeared through in despair.
